# O2V Framework

> O2V Framework, also known as Opportunity-to-Value Framework, is a multi-configuration framework for converting opportunity signals into validated value, business cases, long-term assets, and evidence-backed value stories.

Official site: https://www.o2vframework.com
Backup domain: https://www.opportunity2venture.com, retained as a historical / legacy alias and backup domain
Creator and copyright holder: Li Zhi
Official public release version: O2V Framework 20260607
Internal version: v1.6
Languages: English, Chinese, German

## Public Structure

O2V Framework is the only parent framework.

The default public website entry is the O2V Enterprise Configuration. Its current methodology scope includes AiNOVA and Valence.

AiNOVA is the AI-native Operating Model for Enterprise Value Realization. It is not an IT or Digital & Tech department model.

Valence is the Product Value Operations & Governance Model. It may be used with AiNOVA, but it is not reduced to an AiNOVA submodule.

O2V Venture Configuration is retained as the venture-context configuration for founders, builders, consultants, independent professionals, creators, AI builders, and small teams.

Core Principles are shared by both Enterprise and Venture configurations. Configuration-specific method practices are concrete expressions of the same principles.

Toolkit, Agents, Evidence System, Advisory Services, and Partner Ecosystem are future ecosystem roadmap items.

## Core Chain

Signal -> Scenario -> Persona -> Pain -> Product -> Validation -> Business Case -> Asset -> Value Story

## Public Boundary

The public website content does not disclose detailed playbooks, templates, scorecards, calculation formulas, internal knowledge-base paths, client details, specific systems, or partner names.

Website source code is licensed under Apache License 2.0. O2V methodology, publication text, brand names, logos, PDF materials, AiNOVA, Valence, and derivative methodology assets remain subject to the copyright and rights statements published on the site unless separately licensed in writing.

## Historical Release Note

Opportunity-to-Venture is retained only as historical release wording and as a venture-context configuration. Financing Story can appear only as a venture-context form of Value Story. Current Enterprise Configuration PDF filenames are o2v-framework-enterprise-configuration-20260607-en.pdf, o2v-framework-enterprise-configuration-20260607-zh.pdf, and o2v-framework-enterprise-configuration-20260607-de.pdf.
